france-sovereign-repricing.question: Do unexpected, first-public fiscal/financing shocks cause a delayed, capturable change in French sovereign risk relative to common euro duration risk?
france-sovereign-repricing.mechanism: Investor benchmark/mandate and financing constraints may cause delayed reallocation; this is a hypothesis, not established inefficient pricing.
france-sovereign-repricing.who_pays: Potential investors/hedgers needing immediate sovereign-risk capacity or constrained rebalancing; unverified, not France’s default as a necessary premise.
instrument_mapping_design_only: Euro-OAT/Euro-Bund futures FOAT/FGBL, duration-neutral using prior CTD/conversion-factor/DV01; not a fixed1:1 pair
Cash OAT/Bund requires verified repo/borrow and total-return accounting
CDS is an access/credit/margin/settlement-dependent reserve, not an assumed available retail instrument
france-sovereign-repricing.profit_channel: Relative spread widening may lower hedged French bond value; actual profit depends on tradable prices, prior hedge ratio, carry, collateral, liquidity and execution. Sovereign default is not required.
contradictions: Bad fiscal levels may already be fully priced; missing surprise is not alpha
Fundamental deterioration and unwarranted fragmentation have different ECB TPI treatment; neither unlimited rescue nor inevitable default follows
Yield-index spread is not futures/total-return P&L; Bund safe-haven and CTD/basis can confound it
Fiscal improvement, central-bank/political intervention and carry can reverse a short-France idea
controls_before_any_protocol: First-public information and expectation measured before the event; final revised debt data forbidden as past input
Matched executable bid/ask/timezone/receipt timestamps, latency and failed fills for both legs
Whole fixed event population and clustered event/day uncertainty; no best country, episode, horizon or threshold selected from returns

policy-announcement-repricing.question: Can economically specific public policy surprises predict residual repricing after the lab’s actual information receipt and full executable costs?
policy-announcement-repricing.mechanism: Tariff, sanction, fiscal, monetary, regulatory or policy-reversal news changes expected cashflows or risk premia; residual adjustment after receipt may or may not remain.
policy-announcement-repricing.who_pays: Potential risk-transfer demand and constrained rebalancing by exposed participants; actor name/popularity is not a mechanism.
event_tags_design_only: Policy topic and affected economic exposure
Trump is an issuer/actor tag; presidency/person sentiment is not automatic bullish or bearish direction
three_distinct_inputs: Economic policy content and surprise versus expectations
Investor positioning/risk appetite, which press tone does not measure
policy-announcement-repricing.asset_selection: UNSET. Select one accessible executable economic exposure before outcomes, never the best asset after event returns. No price/asset grid.

policy-announcement-repricing.llm_limit: A current model may remember historical market reactions. Any classification/taxonomy/model must be frozen and evaluated with causal/knowledge-cutoff limits before returns; never optimise a sentiment score on outcomes.
